intent: One empty-state component with three variants (inbox zero, no search results, first project), each with a bespoke ink-line SVG scene, personable copy and clear actions.

layout.emptyState: centred column; py 40px; illustration min(256px, 76%) wide (240x160 viewBox); meta, title, body, extras, actions
layout.searchExtras: suggestion chips (36px pills) between body and actions
layout.projectExtras: dashed rule, then 'Or start from a template' chips with geometric glyphs
layout.demo: header grid (headline 7 cols, intro 5 cols) + three app frames; 1 col below 1024px, 3 cols from 1024px up

responsive.mobile: frames stack full-width; illustration scales to 76% of the frame
responsive.md: header splits into headline and intro

accessibility: real buttons with visible focus rings
role=search form with a labelled input in the demo

project.title: Every project starts as a blank page.

avoid: a grey box icon with 'No data'
